policy: A numbered Specification release records only an exact committed source snapshot, the closed multi-family candidate and corpus closure, and the manifest-owned reference conformance result. The current Specification 1.0 entry remains a candidate until those three prerequisites are committed and closed. A Specification release does not relabel any current 0.x FormRef, publish a Form Package, or advance the independent non-normative official Provider. Recorded releases are append-only.
